title: Remove memory-only success from product Tools and Skills writes

ac_1_no_memory_only_saved_success_on_too.detail: POST /bff/tools, PATCH /bff/tools/{tool_id}, POST /bff/skills, and PATCH /bff/skills/{skill_id} no longer write to or read from process-local tool_registry or skill_registry to manufacture 201/200 saved success. Mutations now delegate through IntegrationsService.mutate_catalog_record() to a configured catalog mutation owner and require confirmed readback through merged_tool_records() / merged_skill_records() before returning 201/200 or caching idempotency.

ac_2_typed_owner_contract_and_explicit_5.detail: OpenClawOpsClient explicitly declares SUPPORTED_CATALOG_METADATA_MUTATIONS = () and supports_catalog_metadata_mutation(operation) -> False because services/openclaw-gateway-adapter exposes only capability/effective-tool/session/invocation/sandbox routes and does not implement durable catalog metadata CRUD (create_tool, update_tool, create_skill, update_skill). DomainWorkflowCatalogPort is a read-only catalog projection port. When neither read_store nor openclaw_client supports catalog metadata mutation, POST/PATCH /bff/tools* and /bff/skills* fail closed with 503 DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE (tool_catalog_owner_unavailable / skill_catalog_owner_unavailable) without invoking any tool/model or command submission. Full end-to-end product catalog authoring usability remains unfinished until a durable catalog metadata owner port is implemented.

ac_3_operator_role_and_tenant_actor_scop.detail: POST /bff/tools and PATCH /bff/tools/{tool_id} now enforce _require_operator(identity) (matching POST /bff/skills and PATCH /bff/skills/{skill_id}) so read-only viewer tokens receive 403 FORBIDDEN. tools_bff_idempotency and skills_bff_idempotency are scoped by (tenant_id, operator_id, resolved_key) and IntegrationsService.identity_tenant_id delegates directly to canonical bff_me_tenant_payload (with X-Tenant-Id / selected_tenant context), preserving allowed_tenants/allowedTenants/tenants/wildcard behavior on legitimate second-tenant requests and rejecting unauthorized foreign tenants with 403 FORBIDDEN while preserving 202 on POST /bff/skills/{id}/sandbox-eval.

ac_4_read_surface_truth_without_memory_o.detail: merged_tool_records() and merged_skill_records() no longer merge process-local tool_registry or skill_registry overlays. GET /bff/tools and GET /bff/skills derive surface status and source from read_store.dataset_source(dataset), reporting status='unavailable', source='missing' when unconfigured and status='ok', source='service_store'|'in_memory' when configured (including when configured and empty). MCP server/tool registries and POST /bff/skills dry-run (200 with durable=False) are preserved.

ac_5_focused_local_tests_and_fresh_insta.detail: Focused tests in test_tools_integrations_router.py and test_bff_consol_skills_mcp_registry_contract.py reproduce the exact sanitized counterexample (viewer 403, unconfigured operator 503, missing surface status='unavailable'/source='missing', configured_command_submission_count == 0), prove positive owner-backed create/patch + fresh IntegrationsService instance readback, prove 503 fail-closed when owner readback is unconfirmed, and verify canonical bff_me_tenant_payload alignment for allowed second-tenant and disallowed foreign-tenant shapes plus tenant/operator idempotency isolation.

prior_review_and_reopen_history.reopened_reason: IntegrationsService.identity_tenant_id re-parsed only primary/tenant_ids and omitted allowed_tenants/allowedTenants/tenants/wildcard behavior
prior_review_and_reopen_history.repair_applied: Removed duplicate tenant parser in IntegrationsService.identity_tenant_id and delegated directly to canonical bff_me_tenant_payload with X-Tenant-Id / selected_tenant context; added focused regression coverage for allowed second-tenant and disallowed foreign-tenant shapes
